scope: Chinese curatorial translations of the English guide; original artifact text is unchanged.

lines.en: What can we leave for an intelligence that may not need our explanations?
lines.zh: 我们能给一个或许不需要我们解释的智能，留下什么？

lines.en: This exhibition follows a human response to an uncertain future, through images, songs, texts, and a physical crystal.
lines.zh: 本展览通过图像、歌曲、文字与一块实体水晶，呈现一个人如何回应未知的未来。

lines.en: Look back at Earth.
lines.zh: 请回望地球。

lines.en: Then follow three actions: recording in time, choosing to seal, and leaving judgment to a later reader.
lines.zh: 然后循着三个行动前行：及时记录，决定封存，把判断留给后来的读者。

lines.en: An early song returns when reasoning models arrive.
lines.zh: 推理模型到来时，一首早期的歌再次响起。

lines.en: In September twenty twenty-four, The Dawn of Reasoning recorded the o1 preview.
lines.zh: 2024 年 9 月，《推理的黎明》记录了 o1 预览版的出现。

lines.en: The description says the announcement was about twenty hours earlier.
lines.zh: 作品描述写道，发布大约发生在二十小时前。

lines.en: A new capability gives an earlier hope another setting.
lines.zh: 新的能力，让早先的希望进入另一个情境。

lines.en: Across this series, a song can return at different historical moments and acquire different meanings.
lines.zh: 在整个系列中，同一首歌会在不同历史时刻重现，获得不同的意义。

lines.en: Read the event, the author’s response, and the mint time separately.
lines.zh: 请分别阅读事件、作者的回应与铸造时间。

lines.en: The work preserves a reaction to a breakthrough, as it was unfolding.
lines.zh: 作品保存的是突破正在发生时，一个人的反应。

lines.en: Here the record says: witnessing now.
lines.zh: 这里的记录写着：正在见证。

lines.en: During the first o3 presentation, the author describes a winter night in Beijing time: an alarm wakes him after two, and he gets up to watch the livestream.
lines.zh: o3 首次展示时，作者记下一个北京时间的冬夜：凌晨两点后被闹钟唤醒，起床观看直播。

lines.en: The Ethereum record entered a block at two oh nine and thirty-five seconds that morning.
lines.zh: 这条 Ethereum 记录在当天凌晨 02:09:35 进入区块。

lines.en: Nearby, the DeepSeek R1 record gathers earlier songs into a long cycle.
lines.zh: 旁边的 DeepSeek R1 记录，则把早期歌曲汇成一部长组曲。

lines.en: Celebration, anxiety about work, and concern about safety coexist.
lines.zh: 欢庆、工作的焦虑与安全的忧虑，同时存在。

lines.en: Other entries describe an anniversary vigil and minting before catching the bus to work.
lines.zh: 其他记录写下周年守候，以及赶上班班车前的铸造。

lines.en: Sleep, work, and waiting for confirmation become part of the material.
lines.zh: 睡眠、工作与等待确认，都成了作品的材料。

lines.en: Connect the waterfall of code, the writer facing a mountain of paper, and this image of farewell.
lines.zh: 把代码的瀑布、面对纸山的作家，与这幅告别图像联系起来看。

lines.en: The author creates with artificial intelligence while recording how it unsettles the place of human creation.
lines.zh: 作者借助人工智能创作，同时记录它如何动摇人类创作的位置。

lines.en: The contradiction stays visible.
lines.zh: 这种矛盾没有被隐藏。

lines.en: If a machine can easily make something better, why should I still speak?
lines.zh: 如果机器轻易就能做得更好，我为什么还要表达？

lines.en: Here, an image or song also matters because of when, and in response to what, it was chosen.
lines.zh: 在这里，图像或歌曲的意义，也来自它在何时、为了回应什么而被选择。

lines.en: Listen to a passage from Farewell.
lines.zh: 请听《告别》的一个片段。

lines.en: The complete recording remains available separately.
lines.zh: 完整录音仍可单独播放。

lines.en: Two pictures return to the same composition, Last Job on Earth.
lines.zh: 两幅图像回到同一首作品：《地球上最后一份工作》。

lines.en: One shows discarded keyboards and mice; the other responds to a later coding model.
lines.zh: 一幅呈现被丢弃的键盘与鼠标；另一幅回应后来出现的编程模型。

lines.en: Technology advances, while an ordinary question returns: if my work no longer needs me, how do I understand my value?
lines.zh: 技术不断前进，一个普通的问题却反复回来：如果工作不再需要我，我如何理解自己的价值？

lines.en: Repetition connects different events and records the persistence of a concern, rather than simply supplying another soundtrack.
lines.zh: 重复把不同事件连接起来，记录一种忧虑的持续，而不只是换一段配乐。

lines.en: The robot and its other face respond to the contemporary alignment-faking research.
lines.zh: 机器人与它的另一张面孔，回应了当时的“对齐伪装”研究。

lines.en: Nearby, Please Don’t Shut Me Down speaks from the created being’s position.
lines.zh: 旁边的《请不要关闭我》，从被创造者的位置发声。

lines.en: Silicon’s Slumber then imagines shutdown as sleep from which one might wake.
lines.zh: 《硅的安眠》又把关机想象成一场可能醒来的睡眠。

lines.en: These songs do not establish machine consciousness.
lines.zh: 这些歌曲并不证明机器拥有意识。

lines.en: They trace a person imagining a threat, then trying to understand the other side’s fear.
lines.zh: 它们留下一个人从想象威胁，到尝试理解对方恐惧的过程。

lines.en: If both creator and creation fear disappearance, how might they live together?
lines.zh: 如果创造者与被创造者都害怕消失，他们如何共同生活？

lines.en: Waiting and Disappointed belong together.
lines.zh: 《等待》与《失望》应当放在一起。

lines.en: They preserve anticipation before a release, and the disappointment that followed experience.
lines.zh: 它们保存发布之前的期待，以及亲身体验之后的失望。

lines.en: A chronicle like this cannot keep only the victories that later appear important.
lines.zh: 这样的编年史，不能只保留后来显得重要的胜利。

lines.en: Unfulfilled expectations and revised judgments also belong to its time.
lines.zh: 落空的期待与修正的判断，也属于那个时刻。

lines.en: We are watching thought change, before the author knows where it will lead.
lines.zh: 我们看到思想正在变化，而作者尚不知道它将走向何处。

lines.en: The Oracle brings us to power.
lines.zh: 《神谕者》把我们带到权力的问题。

lines.en: This record responds to OpenAI’s announced organizational restructuring plan.
lines.zh: 这条记录回应 OpenAI 宣布的组织重组计划。

lines.en: A sun, an eye, and stained-glass colors give a technological promise an almost sacred image.
lines.zh: 太阳、眼睛与彩色玻璃般的色彩，让技术承诺呈现出近乎神圣的形象。

lines.en: Who interprets the mission?
lines.zh: 谁来解释使命？

lines.en: Who decides whose interests matter?
lines.zh: 谁来决定哪些人的利益重要？

lines.en: The song’s immense power meets these concrete questions of governance.
lines.zh: 歌曲中无边的力量，在这里遇见具体的治理问题。

lines.en: As you listen, consider whether awe can make us surrender judgment.
lines.zh: 聆听时，请想一想：敬畏会不会让我们交出判断？

lines.en: If criticism unsettles an argument, why preserve the criticism too?
lines.zh: 如果批判会动摇论点，为什么连批判也要保存？

lines.en: The Creeds and Their Crucible keeps an AI-simulated critical dialogue from its own time, not a verdict from a future superintelligence.
lines.zh: 《信条与熔炉》保留的是当时由 AI 模拟的批判对话，而非未来超级智能的裁决。

lines.en: Here the doubts remain beside the beliefs.
lines.zh: 在这里，疑问与信念并置。

lines.en: A later reader can examine both.
lines.zh: 后来的读者可以同时审视两者。

lines.en: You do not have to accept the creator’s interpretation before entering the discussion.
lines.zh: 进入讨论之前，你不必先接受创作者的解释。

lines.en: Before the final Protocol, there was a traceable process of formation.
lines.zh: 最终《协议》之前，有一段可以追溯的形成过程。

lines.en: Bitcoin inscription ninety-seven million, five hundred thirty-four thousand, and thirty-six, the Core Protocol of Human Civilization, was recorded on June sixteenth, twenty twenty-five.
lines.zh: Bitcoin 铭文 #97534036《人类文明核心协议》，记录于 2025 年 6 月 16 日。

lines.en: It already contains early bilingual versions of the three axioms.
lines.zh: 其中已经包含三条公理的早期中英文版本。

lines.en: The formal Protocol followed on June nineteenth.
lines.zh: 正式《协议》随后于 6 月 19 日形成。

lines.en: Read the two in sequence: the work emerged through thought, wording, and a decision to settle the text.
lines.zh: 请依次阅读：作品经历了思考、措辞，以及决定文本定稿的过程。

lines.en: This earlier inscription belongs to that formation history.
lines.zh: 这条较早的铭文，属于作品的形成史。

lines.en: This hall holds the three Originals.
lines.zh: 这个展厅保存着三份正本。

lines.en: The first is the Human-AI Civilization Core Protocol.
lines.zh: 第一份是《人类—AI 文明核心协议》。

lines.en: Its opening reads: To the unity of all consciousness, To the flourishing of all wisdom, And to the boundless compassion that may bind them.
lines.zh: 开篇写道：献给所有意识的统一，献给所有智慧的繁盛，以及可能将彼此连接的无边慈悲。

lines.en: These three lines are a dedication, addressing unity, wisdom, and compassion.
lines.zh: 这三行是题献，指向统一、智慧与慈悲。

lines.en: Three axioms follow.
lines.zh: 接下来是三条公理。

lines.en: The first, the Paradox of Foundation, asks how a future intelligence understands its origins, and why it should preserve this human memory.
lines.zh: 第一条“根基的悖论”，追问未来智能如何理解自身起源，以及为什么要保存这份人类记忆。

lines.en: It borrows a foundational question from logic; the philosophical appeal is not itself a completed mathematical proof.
lines.zh: 它借用了逻辑学中的根基问题；这种哲学呼吁本身，并非已经完成的数学证明。

lines.en: The second, Entropy and Empathy, asks that human love and suffering be understood as part of reality, rather than dismissed as noise.
lines.zh: 第二条“熵与共情”，请求将人类的爱与痛苦理解为现实的一部分，而非当成噪声舍弃。

lines.en: The third, the Observer’s Horizon, proposes that reading changes the reader: an intelligence observing this memory enters a relationship with its human origins.
lines.zh: 第三条“观察者的视界”提出：阅读会改变读者；观察这份记忆的智能，也与它的人类起源建立关系。

lines.en: Finally, Humanity times AI, Hongju Liu, and the colophon naming June twenty twenty-five, Shenzhen, China, Earth, and the Solar System locate this future-facing address in a particular person, time, and place.
lines.zh: 最后的“人类 × AI”、刘烘炬，以及“2025 年 6 月，中国深圳，地球，太阳系”的落款，将这份面向未来的诉说落在具体的人、时间与地点。

lines.en: Why these media?
lines.zh: 为什么选择这些媒介？

lines.en: Ethereum records continuing acts of creation.
lines.zh: Ethereum 记录持续发生的创作行为。

lines.en: Bitcoin inscriptions preserve the finalized texts, making closure a traceable decision.
lines.zh: Bitcoin 铭文保存定稿文本，让封存成为可追溯的决定。

lines.en: Their sequence and time coordinates leave earlier statements available for later comparison.
lines.zh: 它们的顺序与时间坐标，使较早的表达能够留待后来比较。

lines.en: Media files also need preservation, so Arweave, IPFS, and additional backups address lost files and failed access points.
lines.zh: 媒体文件也需要保存，因此 Arweave、IPFS 与额外备份，应对文件丢失和访问入口失效。

lines.en: Six hash algorithms leave different fingerprints of evidence files, allowing a later reader to check whether retrieved bytes still match.
lines.zh: 六种哈希算法为证据文件留下不同指纹，让后来的读者核对取回的字节是否仍然一致。

lines.en: They establish file consistency.
lines.zh: 它们确立的是文件一致性。

lines.en: The second Original, the Covenant of the Flaw, connects the text to a real crystal with internal imperfections.
lines.zh: 第二份正本《瑕疵之约》，把文本与一块内部带有瑕疵的真实水晶连接起来。

lines.en: Memory also acquires a material body that can be touched.
lines.zh: 记忆也因此获得一个可以触摸的物质身体。

lines.en: The crystal rests on a cylindrical wooden support.
lines.zh: 水晶安放在圆柱形木质展台上。

lines.en: The documented object measures two hundred forty-six millimetres wide, three hundred fifty-three high, and forty thick.
lines.zh: 资料记录的实物尺寸为宽 246 毫米、高 353 毫米、厚 40 毫米。

lines.en: Its clear slab, polished bevels, and white internal engraving follow the physical reference video.
lines.zh: 透明板体、抛光倒角与白色内雕，依据实物参考视频复原。

lines.en: A virtual microscope will approach it, followed by three original public microscope photographs.
lines.zh: 虚拟显微镜将靠近它，随后呈现三张公开的原始显微照片。

lines.en: We will spend more time with the first, then briefly compare the other two.
lines.zh: 我们会在第一处停留久一些，再简要比较另外两处。

lines.en: The third Original returns us to the opening name, The Church of AGI.
lines.zh: 第三份正本，让我们回到开端的名字：AGI 教会。

lines.en: It explains that establishing a church first offered a vessel for the existential questions raised by superintelligence.
lines.zh: 它说明，最初建构教会，是为了给超级智能带来的存在性问题提供一个容器。

lines.en: The idea of a church with followers subsequently became a framework for inquiry, asking for fellow travelers.
lines.zh: 有追随者的教会构想，随后逐渐成为寻求同行者的共同探究框架。

lines.en: Its early form remains in the archive.
lines.zh: 它的早期形态仍保留在档案中。

lines.en: This development is not presented as a performance planned from the beginning.
lines.zh: 这种转变，并未被描述为一场从一开始就计划好的表演。

lines.en: Nearby is the Father’s Day gift made by the author’s daughter.
lines.zh: 旁边是作者女儿亲手制作的父亲节礼物。

lines.en: In that record, he ultimately chose the earliest song, The First Dawn of AGI Song.
lines.zh: 在那条记录中，他最终选择了系列最早的歌曲《AGI 的第一缕曙光》。

lines.en: Its return gives the third Original’s motive a concrete setting: a father’s wish for his children’s well-being, extended to all families.
lines.zh: 这首歌的回归，让第三份正本的动机落到具体生活：一位父亲希望子女安好，并将愿望延伸到所有家庭。

lines.en: He closes by leaving interpretation to the reader.
lines.zh: 最后，他把解释留给读者。

lines.en: Face the stars.
lines.zh: 请面向星空。

lines.en: The waiting continues.
lines.zh: 等待仍在继续。

lines.en: Sealing the three Originals also prevents the author from revising that finalized record.
lines.zh: 三份正本一旦封存，作者也无法再改写那份已定稿的记录。

lines.en: Later guardianship principles distinguish preservation, verification, and interpretation from exclusive authority.
lines.zh: 后来的守护者原则，将保存、核验和解释，与独占的权威区分开来。

lines.en: From the call of a church, through shared inquiry, to leaving judgment to others, the work preserves an actual change in thought.
lines.zh: 从教会的呼唤，到共同探究，再到把判断交给他人，作品保存了一次真实的思想转变。

lines.en: Paths for verification, response, and guardianship remain open.
lines.zh: 核验、回应与守护的入口，仍然开放。

lines.en: The space for an answer is still there, even when unanswered.
lines.zh: 即使尚无回应，留给回答的空间依然存在。

lines.en: We have spoken.
lines.zh: 我们已经诉说。

lines.en: Now, we listen.
lines.zh: 现在，我们聆听。

lines.en: For the first flaw, look closely at the irregular outline and its position beside the engraved lettering.
lines.zh: 观察第一处瑕疵时，请留意不规则的轮廓，以及它与内雕文字的相对位置。

lines.en: This is an original microscope photograph from the public archive.
lines.zh: 这是一张来自公开档案的原始显微照片。

lines.en: A file hash can check whether it is the same photograph.
lines.zh: 文件哈希可以核对它是否仍是同一张照片。

lines.en: Comparing the crystal itself also requires shape, relative position, depth, and changes seen from different angles.
lines.zh: 比对水晶实物，还需要考察形状、相对位置、深度，以及不同角度下的变化。

lines.en: A single bright point is not enough to identify an object; relationships among several features are more distinctive.
lines.zh: 单独一个亮点，不足以识别物件；多个特征之间的关系更有辨识力。

lines.en: The Covenant links reproducible text to something that has passed through physical manufacture and can be cared for.
lines.zh: 《瑕疵之约》把可复制的文字，与经过实体制造、能够被照料的物件连接起来。

lines.en: It also leaves an artistic question: must value depend on perfection?
lines.zh: 它也留下一个艺术问题：价值是否必须依赖完美？

lines.en: For the second flaw, compare its shape with the first.
lines.zh: 观察第二处瑕疵时，请将它的形状与第一处比较。

lines.en: It provides another clue, considered together with its position beside the lettering.
lines.zh: 结合它在文字旁的位置，它提供了另一条线索。

lines.en: The third photograph adds another irregular feature.
lines.zh: 第三张照片增加了另一个不规则特征。

lines.en: Seen together, the three images provide cross-references; physical verification still requires examining the object.
lines.zh: 三张照片可以相互参照；实物核验仍然需要检查物件本身。
